title: AI Consultant (German-speaking, advising mid-sized companies)
description:
Native level German is a must!

I’m currently looking for someone to support me in advising mid-sized companies in Germany on AI, automation, and digital transformation.

The role mainly involves joining consulting calls, identifying potential opportunities within client businesses, discussing suitable approaches, and ideally also helping move deals toward closing.

I’m looking for someone who communicates confidently, understands business processes, and can explain complex topics in a clear and practical way. Experience in AI, automation, consulting, or sales is a strong plus.

This is not a purely theoretical consulting role, I’m looking for someone who can lead conversations well, build trust with clients, and help turn opportunities into actual projects. The implementation of the project will then also be overseen by you if you want.
